repos_data.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
Orchestrate Claude, Codex and Grok in one app. Open-source (MIT), reuses the subscriptions you already pay for.
Plan, build and review software with your coding agents. Work side by side in the App or browser, or use your favourite terminal or IDE.
The missing linter and lsp for AI coding assistants. Validate CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, hooks, MCP. Plugin for all major IDEs included, with autofixes.

11 Claude skills for SEO: page audits, linkbuilding, article writing, E-E-A-T audits, semantic gap analysis, link building. Methodology from Koray   Tuğberk, Kyle Roof, and Lily Ray, plus a generation-time anti-AI-slop ruleset. Production-tested at InhouseSEO
Claude Code (Sub-agent, Custom Commands) for RIPER-5
What Claude Code sends on every turn before you type a word: what it costs, which of it you never used, and which of your skills never reached the agent.
